summary_1line: Ascetic Jajali grows proud after protecting birds on his head, but the merchant-sage Tuladhara teaches him that true righteousness is universal harmlessness.

image_candidates.scene_text: The motionless ascetic Jajali stands like a wooden post while a pair of small birds build a nest and raise their chicks in his matted hair.
Jajali, proud of his austerity, raises his arms and proclaims his merit to the sky before an unseen voice rebukes him.
In the busy market of Baranasi, the humble merchant Tuladhara greets the austere sage Jajali beside his balanced scales and wares.
